scope: Restricted propagation of verified V4 consequences in a degree3 workspace; immutable V3 and witness parents are required

layout.protocol-degree4-propagation.json: Frozen source/binary, all12 retained cases, limits and three parent archives
layout.case-specs/KEY.json: Exact frozen case; witness_case is the unchanged preceding witness case, witness_files binds all15 saved witness payloads
layout.v2/ARM/ID/: Complete saved V2 basis, operation trace and result
layout.cases/KEY/added.rows.u64le: Only new independent rows, in global insertion-ID order after complete V3
layout.cases/KEY/operations.jsonl: Every attempted witness insertion or allowed variable multiplication, including zero reductions
layout.cases/KEY/progress.jsonl: Append-only deterministic summaries every128 operations and at termination; no clock claims
layout.cases/KEY/state.json: First stopping boundary, caps, rank, seed counts, degree counts and restricted-queue status
layout.cases/KEY/pending.json: Entire remaining FIFO queue, including every unprocessed source
layout.cases/KEY/affine.json: Unit row, linear constraints, free variables and every exhaustively checked assignment, including failed equation IDs
layout.cases/KEY/propagation.json: Mathematical outcome before external input bindings
layout.cases/KEY/result.json: Outcome plus frozen input/witness bindings and inherited lower4 provenance
layout.controls/: Positive xyz+1 and negative xyz fixtures, tiny-space checks, production-style traces and replay records
layout.summary.json: Native per-case status join; failed or unattempted cases do not acquire numerical conclusions
layout.status/summary-after-KEY.json: Write-once cumulative summary after each attempted case
layout.logs/,replay/,host.txt,terminal.json: Actual process outcomes, non-secret host and diagnostic launcher boundaries
layout.manifest.sha256: SHA256 of every final raw payload except this inventory
layout.uploader.stop: Terminal marker: request background uploader exit and wait for any active upload before final manifest/upload; prevents concurrent final writers

added_rows_binary.rows: LSB-first bits in little-endian u64 words; unused final-word bits zero; only inserted nonzero rows are stored
added_rows_binary.columns: Same graded colex squarefree columns through degree3 as DEGREE4_WITNESS_FORMAT.json
added_rows_binary.ids: Global row ID equals complete V3 rank plus this file's zero-based row index
added_rows_binary.partial: Header does not assert completion. Truncated/interrupted traces retain admitted prefixes but require explicit prefix verification before any claim

operations.step: Zero-based new-operation index in this phase
operations.source: Either witness_candidate:i, matching the saved249-row order, or parent:GLOBAL_ROW_ID plus variable:ZERO_BASED_INDEX
operations.source_row_sha256: Hash of the dense candidate before reduction
operations.xor_basis_rows: Ordered global reducer IDs; IDs may refer to complete V3 parents or earlier new rows
operations.remainder_sha256: Hash of the complete dense remainder, including zero
operations.remainder_degree: Stored multilinear degree; zero polynomial encoded0
operations.inserted_row: Global inserted row ID or null when remainder is zero
operations.membership_degree_bound: Always4; this is distinct from working_degree3

stopping: First unit certificate, restricted queue exhaustion, row cap or operation cap; unit takes precedence when coincident. All cases attempted without automatic retry.

claims.upper_four: Only verified1 in V4 or exhaustive affine completion of the original ideal; valid even if the restricted queue remains pending
claims.exact_four: Upper4 plus the separately replayed inherited strict degree4 witness
claims.inherited_lower: Original strict witness proves lower4; propagation ranks are not new strict degree5 evidence
claims.null: Unknown exact/global upper LFD is JSON null, not zero or infinity; omitted from numeric export measurements
claims.queue: restricted_queue_exhausted never asserts unrestricted V4 computation or global stabilization
claims.independence: Coordinate witnesses and repeated retained natural inputs are not independent statistical draws
claims.review: Producer and replay verification do not constitute independent scientific review
